subject: Bayern reportedly still chasing Liverpool teen Rio Ngumoha
title: Bayern's seventy million miss

lines.vo: Bayern reportedly offered seventy million euros, then signed someone else.
They still need a left winger, so they keep chasing Liverpool's eighteen-year-old, Rio Ngumoha. Seventy million euros is quite a compliment.
Instead, they signed Ismael Saibari. Plan B arrived, and the left wing is still waiting.
A later report says Liverpool have no plans to sell. Bayern may try again in January or next summer.
An offer, a signing, and still no left winger. That is not a transfer window. That is a waiting room.
Your mates will never guess this. Match news and betting tips at aboutfootball dot UK.

inserts.story: A cartoon club official wheels a barrow stacked with 70 coins up to a gate. Gag: the coins turn into a tall tower. Twist: the gate opens and a different winger walks out.
A cartoon winger arrives wearing a bright shirt on the right wing. Gag: the left wing stays empty with a lonely chair. Twist: a tiny sign on the chair reads Reserved.
